text: No, the property did not lose 67.7 ha of tree cover **after** the EUDR cut-off date (December 31, 2020). The 67.7 ha loss occurred **in 2020**—before the baseline—and no detectable loss events (0.5 ha or larger) occurred between 2021 and 2025. Minor changes under 0.5 ha (e.g., 0.4 ha in 2021) may have gone unrecorded due to pixel resolution limits. The JRC 2020 reference also confirms no forest cover existed on the asset by 2020. Thus, the 67.7 ha loss pre-dates the EUDR compliance window.
